title: Skip re-renders with memo
summary: Combine `memo` with `useCallback` so unrelated updates skip child renders.
prompt: Make `Row` skip re-rendering when the parent's unrelated "Clicked N" counter changes. `onRowRender` is called every time a `Row` renders. Selecting a row must still show "Selected: name".
hints: Wrap the child: `const Row = memo(function Row(…) {…})`.
An inline arrow creates a new function on every render, which defeats `memo`. Stabilise it with `useCallback(…, [])`.
